properties.NAME: Nepal (Malla and hill kingdoms)
properties.NOTE: Upstream splits Nepal between Tibet and the Delhi Sultanate in 1500. Neither ruled it: the Kathmandu valley was held by the Malla kings (divided into three kingdoms about 1484) and the hills by the Baise and Chaubise principalities.
